The '''Hethar system''' was located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="AOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hethar]], home to the domesticated [[Gornt/Legends|gornt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CotG" />
